svg.title: One message, end to end
svg.desc: A message is sealed with XChaCha20 and Poly1305, protected by a convolutional code, modulated into tones, carried through a VoLTE or VoNR voice call, then synchronized, decoded and verified on the other phone. No IP packets, no server and no unencrypted fallback are involved.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A reply leaves Pixel A as ciphertext, crosses the carrier as sound, and is checked again before Pixel B shows it.
